answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 37 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The sparrow register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and opal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 37 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
